scope: ds4_server.c production before native test fixtures
All Python source of exmekh_agent and exmekh_lib, including capabilities, excluding their config owners and documentation strings

compiled_equivalence.method: Compare exact lexical token sequences of cc -E -P before/after, with and without DS4_NO_GPU. Whitespace and comments are excluded; literal bytes and placeholders are preserved.

policy: AGENT.md explicitly requires product prompts, descriptions, errors, diagnostics and labels to live in their domain configuration/resources. make test depends on test-product-text.
limits: The architectural scanner is a regression guard, not a proof for every possible language or dynamically constructed phrase.
Other C engine/backend source files and shell launchers were not migrated in this follow-up.
Protocol syntax, identifiers, documentation and test fixtures remain code/data at their normal boundaries.
